chunks: My father narrated to us, may God be pleased with him, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, who said: Muhammad ibn Hassan al-Razi narrated to us, from Abu Muhammad al-Razi, from Al-Hussein ibn Yazid, from Al-Sakooni, from Abu Abdullah, from his father, peace be upon them both.

God's Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever trims his nails on Friday, God will remove the disease from his fingers and insert the cure into them.' It has been narrated that insanity, leprosy, and vitiligo will not afflict him.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and physical benefits of trimming nails on Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this tradition linking the physical act of grooming on Friday to divine protection from specific ailments like insanity (*junun*) and leprosy (*juzam*). This reflects the Shia emphasis on *sunnah* practices that integrate bodily purity with spiritual well-being, viewing Friday as a day of heightened divine mercy and health.
